3780/*
3781 * qsort_partition_list_value_cmp
3782 *
3783 * Compare two list partition bound datums.
3784 */
3785static int32
3786qsort_partition_list_value_cmp(const void *a, const void *b, void *arg)
3787{
3788	Datum		val1 = ((const PartitionListValue *) a)->value,
3789				val2 = ((const PartitionListValue *) b)->value;
3790	PartitionKey key = (PartitionKey) arg;
3791
3792	return DatumGetInt32(FunctionCall2Coll(&key->partsupfunc[0],
3793										   key->partcollation[0],
3794										   val1, val2));
3795}
3796
3797/*
3798 * qsort_partition_rbound_cmp
3799 *
3800 * Used when sorting range bounds across all range partitions.
3801 */
3802static int32
3803qsort_partition_rbound_cmp(const void *a, const void *b, void *arg)
3804{
3805	PartitionRangeBound *b1 = (*(PartitionRangeBound *const *) a);
3806	PartitionRangeBound *b2 = (*(PartitionRangeBound *const *) b);
3807	PartitionKey key = (PartitionKey) arg;
3808
3809	return compare_range_bounds(key->partnatts, key->partsupfunc,
3810								key->partcollation,
3811								b1, b2);
3812}
3813
3814/*
3815 * get_partition_operator
3816 *
3817 * Return oid of the operator of the given strategy for the given partition
3818 * key column.  It is assumed that the partitioning key is of the same type as
3819 * the chosen partitioning opclass, or at least binary-compatible.  In the
3820 * latter case, *need_relabel is set to true if the opclass is not of a
3821 * polymorphic type (indicating a RelabelType node needed on top), otherwise
3822 * false.
3823 */
3824static Oid
3825get_partition_operator(PartitionKey key, int col, StrategyNumber strategy,
3826					   bool *need_relabel)
3827{
3828	Oid			operoid;
3829
3830	/*
3831	 * Get the operator in the partitioning opfamily using the opclass'
3832	 * declared input type as both left- and righttype.
3833	 */
3834	operoid = get_opfamily_member(key->partopfamily[col],
3835								  key->partopcintype[col],
3836								  key->partopcintype[col],
3837								  strategy);
3838	if (!OidIsValid(operoid))
3839		elog(ERROR, "missing operator %d(%u,%u) in partition opfamily %u",
3840			 strategy, key->partopcintype[col], key->partopcintype[col],
3841			 key->partopfamily[col]);
3842
3843	/*
3844	 * If the partition key column is not of the same type as the operator
3845	 * class and not polymorphic, tell caller to wrap the non-Const expression
3846	 * in a RelabelType.  This matches what parse_coerce.c does.
3847	 */
3848	*need_relabel = (key->parttypid[col] != key->partopcintype[col] &&
3849					 key->partopcintype[col] != RECORDOID &&
3850					 !IsPolymorphicType(key->partopcintype[col]));
3851
3852	return operoid;
3853}
3854
3855/*
3856 * make_partition_op_expr
3857 *		Returns an Expr for the given partition key column with arg1 and
3858 *		arg2 as its leftop and rightop, respectively
3859 */
3860static Expr *
3861make_partition_op_expr(PartitionKey key, int keynum,
3862					   uint16 strategy, Expr *arg1, Expr *arg2)
3863{
3864	Oid			operoid;
3865	bool		need_relabel = false;
3866	Expr	   *result = NULL;
3867
3868	/* Get the correct btree operator for this partitioning column */
3869	operoid = get_partition_operator(key, keynum, strategy, &need_relabel);
3870
3871	/*
3872	 * Chosen operator may be such that the non-Const operand needs to be
3873	 * coerced, so apply the same; see the comment in
3874	 * get_partition_operator().
3875	 */
3876	if (!IsA(arg1, Const) &&
3877		(need_relabel ||
3878		 key->partcollation[keynum] != key->parttypcoll[keynum]))
3879		arg1 = (Expr *) makeRelabelType(arg1,
3880										key->partopcintype[keynum],
3881										-1,
3882										key->partcollation[keynum],
3883										COERCE_EXPLICIT_CAST);
3884
3885	/* Generate the actual expression */
3886	switch (key->strategy)
3887	{
3888		case PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST:
3889			{
3890				List	   *elems = (List *) arg2;
3891				int			nelems = list_length(elems);
3892
3893				Assert(nelems >= 1);
3894				Assert(keynum == 0);
3895
3896				if (nelems > 1 &&
3897					!type_is_array(key->parttypid[keynum]))
3898				{
3899					ArrayExpr  *arrexpr;
3900					ScalarArrayOpExpr *saopexpr;
3901
3902					/* Construct an ArrayExpr for the right-hand inputs */
3903					arrexpr = makeNode(ArrayExpr);
3904					arrexpr->array_typeid =
3905						get_array_type(key->parttypid[keynum]);
3906					arrexpr->array_collid = key->parttypcoll[keynum];
3907					arrexpr->element_typeid = key->parttypid[keynum];
3908					arrexpr->elements = elems;
3909					arrexpr->multidims = false;
3910					arrexpr->location = -1;
3911
3912					/* Build leftop = ANY (rightop) */
3913					saopexpr = makeNode(ScalarArrayOpExpr);
3914					saopexpr->opno = operoid;
3915					saopexpr->opfuncid = get_opcode(operoid);
3916					saopexpr->hashfuncid = InvalidOid;
3917					saopexpr->negfuncid = InvalidOid;
3918					saopexpr->useOr = true;
3919					saopexpr->inputcollid = key->partcollation[keynum];
3920					saopexpr->args = list_make2(arg1, arrexpr);
3921					saopexpr->location = -1;
3922
3923					result = (Expr *) saopexpr;
3924				}
3925				else
3926				{
3927					List	   *elemops = NIL;
3928					ListCell   *lc;
3929
3930					foreach(lc, elems)
3931					{
3932						Expr	   *elem = lfirst(lc),
3933								   *elemop;
3934
3935						elemop = make_opclause(operoid,
3936											   BOOLOID,
3937											   false,
3938											   arg1, elem,
3939											   InvalidOid,
3940											   key->partcollation[keynum]);
3941						elemops = lappend(elemops, elemop);
3942					}
3943
3944					result = nelems > 1 ? makeBoolExpr(OR_EXPR, elemops, -1) : linitial(elemops);
3945				}
3946				break;
3947			}
3948
3949		case PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE:
3950			result = make_opclause(operoid,
3951								   BOOLOID,
3952								   false,
3953								   arg1, arg2,
3954								   InvalidOid,
3955								   key->partcollation[keynum]);
3956			break;
3957
3958		case PARTITION_STRATEGY_HASH:
3959			Assert(false);
3960			break;
3961	}
3962
3963	return result;
3964}
3965
3966/*
3967 * get_qual_for_hash
3968 *
3969 * Returns a CHECK constraint expression to use as a hash partition's
3970 * constraint, given the parent relation and partition bound structure.
3971 *
3972 * The partition constraint for a hash partition is always a call to the
3973 * built-in function satisfies_hash_partition().
3974 */
3975static List *
3976get_qual_for_hash(Relation parent, PartitionBoundSpec *spec)
3977{
3978	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
3979	FuncExpr   *fexpr;
3980	Node	   *relidConst;
3981	Node	   *modulusConst;
3982	Node	   *remainderConst;
3983	List	   *args;
3984	ListCell   *partexprs_item;
3985	int			i;
3986
3987	/* Fixed arguments. */
3988	relidConst = (Node *) makeConst(OIDOID,
3989									-1,
3990									InvalidOid,
3991									sizeof(Oid),
3992									ObjectIdGetDatum(RelationGetRelid(parent)),
3993									false,
3994									true);
3995
3996	modulusConst = (Node *) makeConst(INT4OID,
3997									  -1,
3998									  InvalidOid,
3999									  sizeof(int32),
4000									  Int32GetDatum(spec->modulus),
4001									  false,
4002									  true);
4003
4004	remainderConst = (Node *) makeConst(INT4OID,
4005										-1,
4006										InvalidOid,
4007										sizeof(int32),
4008										Int32GetDatum(spec->remainder),
4009										false,
4010										true);
4011
4012	args = list_make3(relidConst, modulusConst, remainderConst);
4013	partexprs_item = list_head(key->partexprs);
4014
4015	/* Add an argument for each key column. */
4016	for (i = 0; i < key->partnatts; i++)
4017	{
4018		Node	   *keyCol;
4019
4020		/* Left operand */
4021		if (key->partattrs[i] != 0)
4022		{
4023			keyCol = (Node *) makeVar(1,
4024									  key->partattrs[i],
4025									  key->parttypid[i],
4026									  key->parttypmod[i],
4027									  key->parttypcoll[i],
4028									  0);
4029		}
4030		else
4031		{
4032			keyCol = (Node *) copyObject(lfirst(partexprs_item));
4033			partexprs_item = lnext(key->partexprs, partexprs_item);
4034		}
4035
4036		args = lappend(args, keyCol);
4037	}
4038
4039	fexpr = makeFuncExpr(F_SATISFIES_HASH_PARTITION,
4040						 BOOLOID,
4041						 args,
4042						 InvalidOid,
4043						 InvalidOid,
4044						 COERCE_EXPLICIT_CALL);
4045
4046	return list_make1(fexpr);
4047}
4048
4049/*
4050 * get_qual_for_list
4051 *
4052 * Returns an implicit-AND list of expressions to use as a list partition's
4053 * constraint, given the parent relation and partition bound structure.
4054 *
4055 * The function returns NIL for a default partition when it's the only
4056 * partition since in that case there is no constraint.
4057 */
4058static List *
4059get_qual_for_list(Relation parent, PartitionBoundSpec *spec)
4060{
4061	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
4062	List	   *result;
4063	Expr	   *keyCol;
4064	Expr	   *opexpr;
4065	NullTest   *nulltest;
4066	ListCell   *cell;
4067	List	   *elems = NIL;
4068	bool		list_has_null = false;
4069
4070	/*
4071	 * Only single-column list partitioning is supported, so we are worried
4072	 * only about the partition key with index 0.
4073	 */
4074	Assert(key->partnatts == 1);
4075
4076	/* Construct Var or expression representing the partition column */
4077	if (key->partattrs[0] != 0)
4078		keyCol = (Expr *) makeVar(1,
4079								  key->partattrs[0],
4080								  key->parttypid[0],
4081								  key->parttypmod[0],
4082								  key->parttypcoll[0],
4083								  0);
4084	else
4085		keyCol = (Expr *) copyObject(linitial(key->partexprs));
4086
4087	/*
4088	 * For default list partition, collect datums for all the partitions. The
4089	 * default partition constraint should check that the partition key is
4090	 * equal to none of those.
4091	 */
4092	if (spec->is_default)
4093	{
4094		int			i;
4095		int			ndatums = 0;
4096		PartitionDesc pdesc = RelationGetPartitionDesc(parent, false);
4097		PartitionBoundInfo boundinfo = pdesc->boundinfo;
4098
4099		if (boundinfo)
4100		{
4101			ndatums = boundinfo->ndatums;
4102
4103			if (partition_bound_accepts_nulls(boundinfo))
4104				list_has_null = true;
4105		}
4106
4107		/*
4108		 * If default is the only partition, there need not be any partition
4109		 * constraint on it.
4110		 */
4111		if (ndatums == 0 && !list_has_null)
4112			return NIL;
4113
4114		for (i = 0; i < ndatums; i++)
4115		{
4116			Const	   *val;
4117
4118			/*
4119			 * Construct Const from known-not-null datum.  We must be careful
4120			 * to copy the value, because our result has to be able to outlive
4121			 * the relcache entry we're copying from.
4122			 */
4123			val = makeConst(key->parttypid[0],
4124							key->parttypmod[0],
4125							key->parttypcoll[0],
4126							key->parttyplen[0],
4127							datumCopy(*boundinfo->datums[i],
4128									  key->parttypbyval[0],
4129									  key->parttyplen[0]),
4130							false,	/* isnull */
4131							key->parttypbyval[0]);
4132
4133			elems = lappend(elems, val);
4134		}
4135	}
4136	else
4137	{
4138		/*
4139		 * Create list of Consts for the allowed values, excluding any nulls.
4140		 */
4141		foreach(cell, spec->listdatums)
4142		{
4143			Const	   *val = lfirst_node(Const, cell);
4144
4145			if (val->constisnull)
4146				list_has_null = true;
4147			else
4148				elems = lappend(elems, copyObject(val));
4149		}
4150	}
4151
4152	if (elems)
4153	{
4154		/*
4155		 * Generate the operator expression from the non-null partition
4156		 * values.
4157		 */
4158		opexpr = make_partition_op_expr(key, 0, BTEqualStrategyNumber,
4159										keyCol, (Expr *) elems);
4160	}
4161	else
4162	{
4163		/*
4164		 * If there are no partition values, we don't need an operator
4165		 * expression.
4166		 */
4167		opexpr = NULL;
4168	}
4169
4170	if (!list_has_null)
4171	{
4172		/*
4173		 * Gin up a "col IS NOT NULL" test that will be ANDed with the main
4174		 * expression.  This might seem redundant, but the partition routing
4175		 * machinery needs it.
4176		 */
4177		nulltest = makeNode(NullTest);
4178		nulltest->arg = keyCol;
4179		nulltest->nulltesttype = IS_NOT_NULL;
4180		nulltest->argisrow = false;
4181		nulltest->location = -1;
4182
4183		result = opexpr ? list_make2(nulltest, opexpr) : list_make1(nulltest);
4184	}
4185	else
4186	{
4187		/*
4188		 * Gin up a "col IS NULL" test that will be OR'd with the main
4189		 * expression.
4190		 */
4191		nulltest = makeNode(NullTest);
4192		nulltest->arg = keyCol;
4193		nulltest->nulltesttype = IS_NULL;
4194		nulltest->argisrow = false;
4195		nulltest->location = -1;
4196
4197		if (opexpr)
4198		{
4199			Expr	   *or;
4200
4201			or = makeBoolExpr(OR_EXPR, list_make2(nulltest, opexpr), -1);
4202			result = list_make1(or);
4203		}
4204		else
4205			result = list_make1(nulltest);
4206	}
4207
4208	/*
4209	 * Note that, in general, applying NOT to a constraint expression doesn't
4210	 * necessarily invert the set of rows it accepts, because NOT (NULL) is
4211	 * NULL.  However, the partition constraints we construct here never
4212	 * evaluate to NULL, so applying NOT works as intended.
4213	 */
4214	if (spec->is_default)
4215	{
4216		result = list_make1(make_ands_explicit(result));
4217		result = list_make1(makeBoolExpr(NOT_EXPR, result, -1));
4218	}
4219
4220	return result;
4221}
4222
4223/*
4224 * get_qual_for_range
4225 *
4226 * Returns an implicit-AND list of expressions to use as a range partition's
4227 * constraint, given the parent relation and partition bound structure.
4228 *
4229 * For a multi-column range partition key, say (a, b, c), with (al, bl, cl)
4230 * as the lower bound tuple and (au, bu, cu) as the upper bound tuple, we
4231 * generate an expression tree of the following form:
4232 *
4233 *	(a IS NOT NULL) and (b IS NOT NULL) and (c IS NOT NULL)
4234 *		AND
4235 *	(a > al OR (a = al AND b > bl) OR (a = al AND b = bl AND c >= cl))
4236 *		AND
4237 *	(a < au OR (a = au AND b < bu) OR (a = au AND b = bu AND c < cu))
4238 *
4239 * It is often the case that a prefix of lower and upper bound tuples contains
4240 * the same values, for example, (al = au), in which case, we will emit an
4241 * expression tree of the following form:
4242 *
4243 *	(a IS NOT NULL) and (b IS NOT NULL) and (c IS NOT NULL)
4244 *		AND
4245 *	(a = al)
4246 *		AND
4247 *	(b > bl OR (b = bl AND c >= cl))
4248 *		AND
4249 *	(b < bu OR (b = bu AND c < cu))
4250 *
4251 * If a bound datum is either MINVALUE or MAXVALUE, these expressions are
4252 * simplified using the fact that any value is greater than MINVALUE and less
4253 * than MAXVALUE. So, for example, if cu = MAXVALUE, c < cu is automatically
4254 * true, and we need not emit any expression for it, and the last line becomes
4255 *
4256 *	(b < bu) OR (b = bu), which is simplified to (b <= bu)
4257 *
4258 * In most common cases with only one partition column, say a, the following
4259 * expression tree will be generated: a IS NOT NULL AND a >= al AND a < au
4260 *
4261 * For default partition, it returns the negation of the constraints of all
4262 * the other partitions.
4263 *
4264 * External callers should pass for_default as false; we set it to true only
4265 * when recursing.
4266 */
4267static List *
4268get_qual_for_range(Relation parent, PartitionBoundSpec *spec,
4269				   bool for_default)
4270{
4271	List	   *result = NIL;
4272	ListCell   *cell1,
4273			   *cell2,
4274			   *partexprs_item,
4275			   *partexprs_item_saved;
4276	int			i,
4277				j;
4278	PartitionRangeDatum *ldatum,
4279			   *udatum;
4280	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
4281	Expr	   *keyCol;
4282	Const	   *lower_val,
4283			   *upper_val;
4284	List	   *lower_or_arms,
4285			   *upper_or_arms;
4286	int			num_or_arms,
4287				current_or_arm;
4288	ListCell   *lower_or_start_datum,
4289			   *upper_or_start_datum;
4290	bool		need_next_lower_arm,
4291				need_next_upper_arm;
4292
4293	if (spec->is_default)
4294	{
4295		List	   *or_expr_args = NIL;
4296		PartitionDesc pdesc = RelationGetPartitionDesc(parent, false);
4297		Oid		   *inhoids = pdesc->oids;
4298		int			nparts = pdesc->nparts,
4299					k;
4300
4301		for (k = 0; k < nparts; k++)
4302		{
4303			Oid			inhrelid = inhoids[k];
4304			HeapTuple	tuple;
4305			Datum		datum;
4306			PartitionBoundSpec *bspec;
4307
4308			tuple = SearchSysCache1(RELOID, ObjectIdGetDatum(inhrelid));
4309			if (!HeapTupleIsValid(tuple))
4310				elog(ERROR, "cache lookup failed for relation %u", inhrelid);
4311
4312			datum = SysCacheGetAttrNotNull(RELOID, tuple,
4313										   Anum_pg_class_relpartbound);
4314			bspec = (PartitionBoundSpec *)
4315				stringToNode(TextDatumGetCString(datum));
4316			if (!IsA(bspec, PartitionBoundSpec))
4317				elog(ERROR, "expected PartitionBoundSpec");
4318
4319			if (!bspec->is_default)
4320			{
4321				List	   *part_qual;
4322
4323				part_qual = get_qual_for_range(parent, bspec, true);
4324
4325				/*
4326				 * AND the constraints of the partition and add to
4327				 * or_expr_args
4328				 */
4329				or_expr_args = lappend(or_expr_args, list_length(part_qual) > 1
4330									   ? makeBoolExpr(AND_EXPR, part_qual, -1)
4331									   : linitial(part_qual));
4332			}
4333			ReleaseSysCache(tuple);
4334		}
4335
4336		if (or_expr_args != NIL)
4337		{
4338			Expr	   *other_parts_constr;
4339
4340			/*
4341			 * Combine the constraints obtained for non-default partitions
4342			 * using OR.  As requested, each of the OR's args doesn't include
4343			 * the NOT NULL test for partition keys (which is to avoid its
4344			 * useless repetition).  Add the same now.
4345			 */
4346			other_parts_constr =
4347				makeBoolExpr(AND_EXPR,
4348							 lappend(get_range_nulltest(key),
4349									 list_length(or_expr_args) > 1
4350									 ? makeBoolExpr(OR_EXPR, or_expr_args,
4351													-1)
4352									 : linitial(or_expr_args)),
4353							 -1);
4354
4355			/*
4356			 * Finally, the default partition contains everything *NOT*
4357			 * contained in the non-default partitions.
4358			 */
4359			result = list_make1(makeBoolExpr(NOT_EXPR,
4360											 list_make1(other_parts_constr), -1));
4361		}
4362
4363		return result;
4364	}
4365
4366	/*
4367	 * If it is the recursive call for default, we skip the get_range_nulltest
4368	 * to avoid accumulating the NullTest on the same keys for each partition.
4369	 */
4370	if (!for_default)
4371		result = get_range_nulltest(key);
4372
4373	/*
4374	 * Iterate over the key columns and check if the corresponding lower and
4375	 * upper datums are equal using the btree equality operator for the
4376	 * column's type.  If equal, we emit single keyCol = common_value
4377	 * expression.  Starting from the first column for which the corresponding
4378	 * lower and upper bound datums are not equal, we generate OR expressions
4379	 * as shown in the function's header comment.
4380	 */
4381	i = 0;
4382	partexprs_item = list_head(key->partexprs);
4383	partexprs_item_saved = partexprs_item;	/* placate compiler */
4384	forboth(cell1, spec->lowerdatums, cell2, spec->upperdatums)
4385	{
4386		EState	   *estate;
4387		MemoryContext oldcxt;
4388		Expr	   *test_expr;
4389		ExprState  *test_exprstate;
4390		Datum		test_result;
4391		bool		isNull;
4392
4393		ldatum = lfirst_node(PartitionRangeDatum, cell1);
4394		udatum = lfirst_node(PartitionRangeDatum, cell2);
4395
4396		/*
4397		 * Since get_range_key_properties() modifies partexprs_item, and we
4398		 * might need to start over from the previous expression in the later
4399		 * part of this function, save away the current value.
4400		 */
4401		partexprs_item_saved = partexprs_item;
4402
4403		get_range_key_properties(key, i, ldatum, udatum,
4404								 &partexprs_item,
4405								 &keyCol,
4406								 &lower_val, &upper_val);
4407
4408		/*
4409		 * If either value is NULL, the corresponding partition bound is
4410		 * either MINVALUE or MAXVALUE, and we treat them as unequal, because
4411		 * even if they're the same, there is no common value to equate the
4412		 * key column with.
4413		 */
4414		if (!lower_val || !upper_val)
4415			break;
4416
4417		/* Create the test expression */
4418		estate = CreateExecutorState();
4419		oldcxt = MemoryContextSwitchTo(estate->es_query_cxt);
4420		test_expr = make_partition_op_expr(key, i, BTEqualStrategyNumber,
4421										   (Expr *) lower_val,
4422										   (Expr *) upper_val);
4423		fix_opfuncids((Node *) test_expr);
4424		test_exprstate = ExecInitExpr(test_expr, NULL);
4425		test_result = ExecEvalExprSwitchContext(test_exprstate,
4426												GetPerTupleExprContext(estate),
4427												&isNull);
4428		MemoryContextSwitchTo(oldcxt);
4429		FreeExecutorState(estate);
4430
4431		/* If not equal, go generate the OR expressions */
4432		if (!DatumGetBool(test_result))
4433			break;
4434
4435		/*
4436		 * The bounds for the last key column can't be equal, because such a
4437		 * range partition would never be allowed to be defined (it would have
4438		 * an empty range otherwise).
4439		 */
4440		if (i == key->partnatts - 1)
4441			elog(ERROR, "invalid range bound specification");
4442
4443		/* Equal, so generate keyCol = lower_val expression */
4444		result = lappend(result,
4445						 make_partition_op_expr(key, i, BTEqualStrategyNumber,
4446												keyCol, (Expr *) lower_val));
4447
4448		i++;
4449	}
4450
4451	/* First pair of lower_val and upper_val that are not equal. */
4452	lower_or_start_datum = cell1;
4453	upper_or_start_datum = cell2;
4454
4455	/* OR will have as many arms as there are key columns left. */
4456	num_or_arms = key->partnatts - i;
4457	current_or_arm = 0;
4458	lower_or_arms = upper_or_arms = NIL;
4459	need_next_lower_arm = need_next_upper_arm = true;
4460	while (current_or_arm < num_or_arms)
4461	{
4462		List	   *lower_or_arm_args = NIL,
4463				   *upper_or_arm_args = NIL;
4464
4465		/* Restart scan of columns from the i'th one */
4466		j = i;
4467		partexprs_item = partexprs_item_saved;
4468
4469		for_both_cell(cell1, spec->lowerdatums, lower_or_start_datum,
4470					  cell2, spec->upperdatums, upper_or_start_datum)
4471		{
4472			PartitionRangeDatum *ldatum_next = NULL,
4473					   *udatum_next = NULL;
4474
4475			ldatum = lfirst_node(PartitionRangeDatum, cell1);
4476			if (lnext(spec->lowerdatums, cell1))
4477				ldatum_next = castNode(PartitionRangeDatum,
4478									   lfirst(lnext(spec->lowerdatums, cell1)));
4479			udatum = lfirst_node(PartitionRangeDatum, cell2);
4480			if (lnext(spec->upperdatums, cell2))
4481				udatum_next = castNode(PartitionRangeDatum,
4482									   lfirst(lnext(spec->upperdatums, cell2)));
4483			get_range_key_properties(key, j, ldatum, udatum,
4484									 &partexprs_item,
4485									 &keyCol,
4486									 &lower_val, &upper_val);
4487
4488			if (need_next_lower_arm && lower_val)
4489			{
4490				uint16		strategy;
4491
4492				/*
4493				 * For the non-last columns of this arm, use the EQ operator.
4494				 * For the last column of this arm, use GT, unless this is the
4495				 * last column of the whole bound check, or the next bound
4496				 * datum is MINVALUE, in which case use GE.
4497				 */
4498				if (j - i < current_or_arm)
4499					strategy = BTEqualStrategyNumber;
4500				else if (j == key->partnatts - 1 ||
4501						 (ldatum_next &&
4502						  ldatum_next->kind == PARTITION_RANGE_DATUM_MINVALUE))
4503					strategy = BTGreaterEqualStrategyNumber;
4504				else
4505					strategy = BTGreaterStrategyNumber;
4506
4507				lower_or_arm_args = lappend(lower_or_arm_args,
4508											make_partition_op_expr(key, j,
4509																   strategy,
4510																   keyCol,
4511																   (Expr *) lower_val));
4512			}
4513
4514			if (need_next_upper_arm && upper_val)
4515			{
4516				uint16		strategy;
4517
4518				/*
4519				 * For the non-last columns of this arm, use the EQ operator.
4520				 * For the last column of this arm, use LT, unless the next
4521				 * bound datum is MAXVALUE, in which case use LE.
4522				 */
4523				if (j - i < current_or_arm)
4524					strategy = BTEqualStrategyNumber;
4525				else if (udatum_next &&
4526						 udatum_next->kind == PARTITION_RANGE_DATUM_MAXVALUE)
4527					strategy = BTLessEqualStrategyNumber;
4528				else
4529					strategy = BTLessStrategyNumber;
4530
4531				upper_or_arm_args = lappend(upper_or_arm_args,
4532											make_partition_op_expr(key, j,
4533																   strategy,
4534																   keyCol,
4535																   (Expr *) upper_val));
4536			}
4537
4538			/*
4539			 * Did we generate enough of OR's arguments?  First arm considers
4540			 * the first of the remaining columns, second arm considers first
4541			 * two of the remaining columns, and so on.
4542			 */
4543			++j;
4544			if (j - i > current_or_arm)
4545			{
4546				/*
4547				 * We must not emit any more arms if the new column that will
4548				 * be considered is unbounded, or this one was.
4549				 */
4550				if (!lower_val || !ldatum_next ||
4551					ldatum_next->kind != PARTITION_RANGE_DATUM_VALUE)
4552					need_next_lower_arm = false;
4553				if (!upper_val || !udatum_next ||
4554					udatum_next->kind != PARTITION_RANGE_DATUM_VALUE)
4555					need_next_upper_arm = false;
4556				break;
4557			}
4558		}
4559
4560		if (lower_or_arm_args != NIL)
4561			lower_or_arms = lappend(lower_or_arms,
4562									list_length(lower_or_arm_args) > 1
4563									? makeBoolExpr(AND_EXPR, lower_or_arm_args, -1)
4564									: linitial(lower_or_arm_args));
4565
4566		if (upper_or_arm_args != NIL)
4567			upper_or_arms = lappend(upper_or_arms,
4568									list_length(upper_or_arm_args) > 1
4569									? makeBoolExpr(AND_EXPR, upper_or_arm_args, -1)
4570									: linitial(upper_or_arm_args));
4571
4572		/* If no work to do in the next iteration, break away. */
4573		if (!need_next_lower_arm && !need_next_upper_arm)
4574			break;
4575
4576		++current_or_arm;
4577	}
4578
4579	/*
4580	 * Generate the OR expressions for each of lower and upper bounds (if
4581	 * required), and append to the list of implicitly ANDed list of
4582	 * expressions.
4583	 */
4584	if (lower_or_arms != NIL)
4585		result = lappend(result,
4586						 list_length(lower_or_arms) > 1
4587						 ? makeBoolExpr(OR_EXPR, lower_or_arms, -1)
4588						 : linitial(lower_or_arms));
4589	if (upper_or_arms != NIL)
4590		result = lappend(result,
4591						 list_length(upper_or_arms) > 1
4592						 ? makeBoolExpr(OR_EXPR, upper_or_arms, -1)
4593						 : linitial(upper_or_arms));
4594
4595	/*
4596	 * As noted above, for non-default, we return list with constant TRUE. If
4597	 * the result is NIL during the recursive call for default, it implies
4598	 * this is the only other partition which can hold every value of the key
4599	 * except NULL. Hence we return the NullTest result skipped earlier.
4600	 */
4601	if (result == NIL)
4602		result = for_default
4603			? get_range_nulltest(key)
4604			: list_make1(makeBoolConst(true, false));
4605
4606	return result;
4607}
4608
4609/*
4610 * get_range_key_properties
4611 *		Returns range partition key information for a given column
4612 *
4613 * This is a subroutine for get_qual_for_range, and its API is pretty
4614 * specialized to that caller.
4615 *
4616 * Constructs an Expr for the key column (returned in *keyCol) and Consts
4617 * for the lower and upper range limits (returned in *lower_val and
4618 * *upper_val).  For MINVALUE/MAXVALUE limits, NULL is returned instead of
4619 * a Const.  All of these structures are freshly palloc'd.
4620 *
4621 * *partexprs_item points to the cell containing the next expression in
4622 * the key->partexprs list, or NULL.  It may be advanced upon return.
4623 */
4624static void
4625get_range_key_properties(PartitionKey key, int keynum,
4626						 PartitionRangeDatum *ldatum,
4627						 PartitionRangeDatum *udatum,
4628						 ListCell **partexprs_item,
4629						 Expr **keyCol,
4630						 Const **lower_val, Const **upper_val)
4631{
4632	/* Get partition key expression for this column */
4633	if (key->partattrs[keynum] != 0)
4634	{
4635		*keyCol = (Expr *) makeVar(1,
4636								   key->partattrs[keynum],
4637								   key->parttypid[keynum],
4638								   key->parttypmod[keynum],
4639								   key->parttypcoll[keynum],
4640								   0);
4641	}
4642	else
4643	{
4644		if (*partexprs_item == NULL)
4645			elog(ERROR, "wrong number of partition key expressions");
4646		*keyCol = copyObject(lfirst(*partexprs_item));
4647		*partexprs_item = lnext(key->partexprs, *partexprs_item);
4648	}
4649
4650	/* Get appropriate Const nodes for the bounds */
4651	if (ldatum->kind == PARTITION_RANGE_DATUM_VALUE)
4652		*lower_val = castNode(Const, copyObject(ldatum->value));
4653	else
4654		*lower_val = NULL;
4655
4656	if (udatum->kind == PARTITION_RANGE_DATUM_VALUE)
4657		*upper_val = castNode(Const, copyObject(udatum->value));
4658	else
4659		*upper_val = NULL;
4660}
4661
4662/*
4663 * get_range_nulltest
4664 *
4665 * A non-default range partition table does not currently allow partition
4666 * keys to be null, so emit an IS NOT NULL expression for each key column.
4667 */
4668static List *
4669get_range_nulltest(PartitionKey key)
4670{
4671	List	   *result = NIL;
4672	NullTest   *nulltest;
4673	ListCell   *partexprs_item;
4674	int			i;
4675
4676	partexprs_item = list_head(key->partexprs);
4677	for (i = 0; i < key->partnatts; i++)
4678	{
4679		Expr	   *keyCol;
4680
4681		if (key->partattrs[i] != 0)
4682		{
4683			keyCol = (Expr *) makeVar(1,
4684									  key->partattrs[i],
4685									  key->parttypid[i],
4686									  key->parttypmod[i],
4687									  key->parttypcoll[i],
4688									  0);
4689		}
4690		else
4691		{
4692			if (partexprs_item == NULL)
4693				elog(ERROR, "wrong number of partition key expressions");
4694			keyCol = copyObject(lfirst(partexprs_item));
4695			partexprs_item = lnext(key->partexprs, partexprs_item);
4696		}
4697
4698		nulltest = makeNode(NullTest);
4699		nulltest->arg = keyCol;
4700		nulltest->nulltesttype = IS_NOT_NULL;
4701		nulltest->argisrow = false;
4702		nulltest->location = -1;
4703		result = lappend(result, nulltest);
4704	}
4705
4706	return result;
4707}
4708
4709/*
4710 * compute_partition_hash_value
4711 *
4712 * Compute the hash value for given partition key values.
4713 */
4714uint64
4715compute_partition_hash_value(int partnatts, FmgrInfo *partsupfunc, const Oid *partcollation,
4716							 const Datum *values, const bool *isnull)
4717{
4718	int			i;
4719	uint64		rowHash = 0;
4720	Datum		seed = UInt64GetDatum(HASH_PARTITION_SEED);
4721
4722	for (i = 0; i < partnatts; i++)
4723	{
4724		/* Nulls are just ignored */
4725		if (!isnull[i])
4726		{
4727			Datum		hash;
4728
4729			Assert(OidIsValid(partsupfunc[i].fn_oid));
4730
4731			/*
4732			 * Compute hash for each datum value by calling respective
4733			 * datatype-specific hash functions of each partition key
4734			 * attribute.
4735			 */
4736			hash = FunctionCall2Coll(&partsupfunc[i], partcollation[i],
4737									 values[i], seed);
4738
4739			/* Form a single 64-bit hash value */
4740			rowHash = hash_combine64(rowHash, DatumGetUInt64(hash));
4741		}
4742	}
4743
4744	return rowHash;
4745}
4746
4747/*
4748 * satisfies_hash_partition
4749 *
4750 * This is an SQL-callable function for use in hash partition constraints.
4751 * The first three arguments are the parent table OID, modulus, and remainder.
4752 * The remaining arguments are the value of the partitioning columns (or
4753 * expressions); these are hashed and the results are combined into a single
4754 * hash value by calling hash_combine64.
4755 *
4756 * Returns true if remainder produced when this computed single hash value is
4757 * divided by the given modulus is equal to given remainder, otherwise false.
4758 * NB: it's important that this never return null, as the constraint machinery
4759 * would consider that to be a "pass".
4760 *
4761 * See get_qual_for_hash() for usage.
4762 */
4763Datum
4764satisfies_hash_partition(PG_FUNCTION_ARGS)
4765{
4766	typedef struct ColumnsHashData
4767	{
4768		Oid			relid;
4769		int			nkeys;
4770		Oid			variadic_type;
4771		int16		variadic_typlen;
4772		bool		variadic_typbyval;
4773		char		variadic_typalign;
4774		Oid			partcollid[PARTITION_MAX_KEYS];
4775		FmgrInfo	partsupfunc[FLEXIBLE_ARRAY_MEMBER];
4776	} ColumnsHashData;
4777	Oid			parentId;
4778	int			modulus;
4779	int			remainder;
4780	Datum		seed = UInt64GetDatum(HASH_PARTITION_SEED);
4781	ColumnsHashData *my_extra;
4782	uint64		rowHash = 0;
4783
4784	/* Return false if the parent OID, modulus, or remainder is NULL. */
4785	if (PG_ARGISNULL(0) || PG_ARGISNULL(1) || PG_ARGISNULL(2))
4786		PG_RETURN_BOOL(false);
4787	parentId = PG_GETARG_OID(0);
4788	modulus = PG_GETARG_INT32(1);
4789	remainder = PG_GETARG_INT32(2);
4790
4791	/* Sanity check modulus and remainder. */
4792	if (modulus <= 0)
4793		ereport(ERROR,
4794				(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4795				 errmsg("modulus for hash partition must be an integer value greater than zero")));
4796	if (remainder < 0)
4797		ereport(ERROR,
4798				(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4799				 errmsg("remainder for hash partition must be an integer value greater than or equal to zero")));
4800	if (remainder >= modulus)
4801		ereport(ERROR,
4802				(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4803				 errmsg("remainder for hash partition must be less than modulus")));
4804
4805	/*
4806	 * Cache hash function information.
4807	 */
4808	my_extra = (ColumnsHashData *) fcinfo->flinfo->fn_extra;
4809	if (my_extra == NULL || my_extra->relid != parentId)
4810	{
4811		Relation	parent;
4812		PartitionKey key;
4813		int			j;
4814
4815		/* Open parent relation and fetch partition key info */
4816		parent = relation_open(parentId, AccessShareLock);
4817		key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
4818
4819		/* Reject parent table that is not hash-partitioned. */
4820		if (key == NULL || key->strategy != PARTITION_STRATEGY_HASH)
4821			ereport(ERROR,
4822					(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4823					 errmsg("\"%s\" is not a hash partitioned table",
4824							get_rel_name(parentId))));
4825
4826		if (!get_fn_expr_variadic(fcinfo->flinfo))
4827		{
4828			int			nargs = PG_NARGS() - 3;
4829
4830			/* complain if wrong number of column values */
4831			if (key->partnatts != nargs)
4832				ereport(ERROR,
4833						(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4834						 errmsg("number of partitioning columns (%d) does not match number of partition keys provided (%d)",
4835								key->partnatts, nargs)));
4836
4837			/* allocate space for our cache */
4838			fcinfo->flinfo->fn_extra =
4839				MemoryContextAllocZero(fcinfo->flinfo->fn_mcxt,
4840									   offsetof(ColumnsHashData, partsupfunc) +
4841									   sizeof(FmgrInfo) * nargs);
4842			my_extra = (ColumnsHashData *) fcinfo->flinfo->fn_extra;
4843			my_extra->relid = parentId;
4844			my_extra->nkeys = key->partnatts;
4845			memcpy(my_extra->partcollid, key->partcollation,
4846				   key->partnatts * sizeof(Oid));
4847
4848			/* check argument types and save fmgr_infos */
4849			for (j = 0; j < key->partnatts; ++j)
4850			{
4851				Oid			argtype = get_fn_expr_argtype(fcinfo->flinfo, j + 3);
4852
4853				if (argtype != key->parttypid[j] && !IsBinaryCoercible(argtype, key->parttypid[j]))
4854					ereport(ERROR,
4855							(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4856							 errmsg("column %d of the partition key has type %s, but supplied value is of type %s",
4857									j + 1, format_type_be(key->parttypid[j]), format_type_be(argtype))));
4858
4859				fmgr_info_copy(&my_extra->partsupfunc[j],
4860							   &key->partsupfunc[j],
4861							   fcinfo->flinfo->fn_mcxt);
4862			}
4863		}
4864		else if (PG_ARGISNULL(3))
4865		{
4866			/* Special case for VARIADIC NULL::sometype[] */
4867			relation_close(parent, NoLock);
4868			PG_RETURN_BOOL(false);
4869		}
4870		else
4871		{
4872			ArrayType  *variadic_array = PG_GETARG_ARRAYTYPE_P(3);
4873
4874			/* allocate space for our cache -- just one FmgrInfo in this case */
4875			fcinfo->flinfo->fn_extra =
4876				MemoryContextAllocZero(fcinfo->flinfo->fn_mcxt,
4877									   offsetof(ColumnsHashData, partsupfunc) +
4878									   sizeof(FmgrInfo));
4879			my_extra = (ColumnsHashData *) fcinfo->flinfo->fn_extra;
4880			my_extra->relid = parentId;
4881			my_extra->nkeys = key->partnatts;
4882			my_extra->variadic_type = ARR_ELEMTYPE(variadic_array);
4883			get_typlenbyvalalign(my_extra->variadic_type,
4884								 &my_extra->variadic_typlen,
4885								 &my_extra->variadic_typbyval,
4886								 &my_extra->variadic_typalign);
4887			my_extra->partcollid[0] = key->partcollation[0];
4888
4889			/* check argument types */
4890			for (j = 0; j < key->partnatts; ++j)
4891				if (key->parttypid[j] != my_extra->variadic_type)
4892					ereport(ERROR,
4893							(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4894							 errmsg("column %d of the partition key has type \"%s\", but supplied value is of type \"%s\"",
4895									j + 1,
4896									format_type_be(key->parttypid[j]),
4897									format_type_be(my_extra->variadic_type))));
4898
4899			fmgr_info_copy(&my_extra->partsupfunc[0],
4900						   &key->partsupfunc[0],
4901						   fcinfo->flinfo->fn_mcxt);
4902		}
4903
4904		/* Hold lock until commit */
4905		relation_close(parent, NoLock);
4906	}
4907
4908	if (!OidIsValid(my_extra->variadic_type))
4909	{
4910		int			nkeys = my_extra->nkeys;
4911		int			i;
4912
4913		/*
4914		 * For a non-variadic call, neither the number of arguments nor their
4915		 * types can change across calls, so avoid the expense of rechecking
4916		 * here.
4917		 */
4918
4919		for (i = 0; i < nkeys; i++)
4920		{
4921			Datum		hash;
4922
4923			/* keys start from fourth argument of function. */
4924			int			argno = i + 3;
4925
4926			if (PG_ARGISNULL(argno))
4927				continue;
4928
4929			hash = FunctionCall2Coll(&my_extra->partsupfunc[i],
4930									 my_extra->partcollid[i],
4931									 PG_GETARG_DATUM(argno),
4932									 seed);
4933
4934			/* Form a single 64-bit hash value */
4935			rowHash = hash_combine64(rowHash, DatumGetUInt64(hash));
4936		}
4937	}
4938	else
4939	{
4940		ArrayType  *variadic_array;
4941		int			i;
4942		int			nelems;
4943		Datum	   *datum;
4944		bool	   *isnull;
4945
4946		/* Special case for VARIADIC NULL::sometype[] */
4947		if (PG_ARGISNULL(3))
4948			PG_RETURN_BOOL(false);
4949
4950		variadic_array = PG_GETARG_ARRAYTYPE_P(3);
4951
4952		deconstruct_array(variadic_array,
4953						  my_extra->variadic_type,
4954						  my_extra->variadic_typlen,
4955						  my_extra->variadic_typbyval,
4956						  my_extra->variadic_typalign,
4957						  &datum, &isnull, &nelems);
4958
4959		/* complain if wrong number of column values */
4960		if (nelems != my_extra->nkeys)
4961			ereport(ERROR,
4962					(errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE),
4963					 errmsg("number of partitioning columns (%d) does not match number of partition keys provided (%d)",
4964							my_extra->nkeys, nelems)));
4965
4966		for (i = 0; i < nelems; i++)
4967		{
4968			Datum		hash;
4969
4970			if (isnull[i])
4971				continue;
4972
4973			hash = FunctionCall2Coll(&my_extra->partsupfunc[0],
4974									 my_extra->partcollid[0],
4975									 datum[i],
4976									 seed);
4977
4978			/* Form a single 64-bit hash value */
4979			rowHash = hash_combine64(rowHash, DatumGetUInt64(hash));
4980		}
4981	}
4982
4983	PG_RETURN_BOOL(rowHash % modulus == remainder);
4984}
4985
4986/*
4987 * check_two_partitions_bounds_range
4988 *
4989 * (function for BY RANGE partitioning)
4990 *
4991 * This is a helper function for check_partitions_for_split() and
4992 * calculate_partition_bound_for_merge().  This function compares the upper
4993 * bound of first_bound and the lower bound of second_bound.  These bounds
4994 * should be equal except when "defaultPart == true" (this means that one of
4995 * the split partitions is DEFAULT).  In this case, the upper bound of
4996 * first_bound can be less than the lower bound of second_bound because
4997 * the space between these bounds will be included in the DEFAULT partition.
4998 *
4999 * parent:			partitioned table
5000 * first_name:		name of the first partition
5001 * first_bound:		bound of the first partition
5002 * second_name:		name of the second partition
5003 * second_bound:	bound of the second partition
5004 * defaultPart:		true if one of the new partitions is DEFAULT
5005 * is_merge:		true indicates the operation is MERGE PARTITIONS;
5006 * 					false indicates the operation is SPLIT PARTITION.
5007 * pstate:			pointer to ParseState struct for determining error position
5008 */
5009static void
5010check_two_partitions_bounds_range(Relation parent,
5011								  RangeVar *first_name,
5012								  PartitionBoundSpec *first_bound,
5013								  RangeVar *second_name,
5014								  PartitionBoundSpec *second_bound,
5015								  bool defaultPart,
5016								  bool is_merge,
5017								  ParseState *pstate)
5018{
5019	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5020	PartitionRangeBound *first_upper;
5021	PartitionRangeBound *second_lower;
5022	int			cmpval;
5023
5024	Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE);
5025
5026	first_upper = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, first_bound->upperdatums, false);
5027	second_lower = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, second_bound->lowerdatums, true);
5028
5029	/*
5030	 * lower1 argument of partition_rbound_cmp() is set to false for the
5031	 * correct comparison result of the lower and upper bounds.
5032	 */
5033	cmpval = partition_rbound_cmp(key->partnatts,
5034								  key->partsupfunc,
5035								  key->partcollation,
5036								  second_lower->datums, second_lower->kind,
5037								  false, first_upper);
5038	if ((!defaultPart && cmpval) || (defaultPart && cmpval < 0))
5039	{
5040		PartitionRangeDatum *datum = linitial(second_bound->lowerdatums);
5041
5042		if (is_merge)
5043			ereport(ERROR,
5044					errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5045					errmsg("cannot merge partition \"%s\" together with partition \"%s\"",
5046						   second_name->relname, first_name->relname),
5047					errdetail("The lower bound of partition \"%s\" is not equal to the upper bound of partition \"%s\".",
5048							  second_name->relname, first_name->relname),
5049					errhint("ALTER TABLE ... MERGE PARTITIONS requires the partition bounds to be adjacent."),
5050					parser_errposition(pstate, datum->location));
5051		else
5052			ereport(ERROR,
5053					errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5054					errmsg("cannot split to partition \"%s\" together with partition \"%s\"",
5055						   second_name->relname, first_name->relname),
5056					errdetail("The lower bound of partition \"%s\" is not equal to the upper bound of partition \"%s\".",
5057							  second_name->relname, first_name->relname),
5058					errhint("ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT PARTITION requires the partition bounds to be adjacent."),
5059					parser_errposition(pstate, datum->location));
5060	}
5061}
5062
5063/*
5064 * get_partition_bound_spec
5065 *
5066 * Returns the PartitionBoundSpec for the partition with the given OID partOid.
5067 */
5068static PartitionBoundSpec *
5069get_partition_bound_spec(Oid partOid)
5070{
5071	HeapTuple	tuple;
5072	Datum		datum;
5073	bool		isnull;
5074	PartitionBoundSpec *boundspec = NULL;
5075
5076	/* Try fetching the tuple from the catcache, for speed. */
5077	tuple = SearchSysCache1(RELOID, ObjectIdGetDatum(partOid));
5078	if (!HeapTupleIsValid(tuple))
5079		elog(ERROR, "cache lookup failed for relation %u", partOid);
5080
5081	datum = SysCacheGetAttr(RELOID, tuple,
5082							Anum_pg_class_relpartbound,
5083							&isnull);
5084	if (isnull)
5085		elog(ERROR, "partition bound for relation %u is null",
5086			 partOid);
5087
5088	boundspec = stringToNode(TextDatumGetCString(datum));
5089
5090	if (!IsA(boundspec, PartitionBoundSpec))
5091		elog(ERROR, "expected PartitionBoundSpec for relation %u",
5092			 partOid);
5093
5094	ReleaseSysCache(tuple);
5095	return boundspec;
5096}
5097
5098/*
5099 * calculate_partition_bound_for_merge
5100 *
5101 * Calculates the bound of the merged partition "spec" by using the bounds of
5102 * the partitions to be merged.
5103 *
5104 * parent:			partitioned table
5105 * partNames:		names of partitions to be merged
5106 * partOids:		Oids of partitions to be merged
5107 * spec (out):		bounds specification of the merged partition
5108 * pstate:			pointer to ParseState struct to determine error position
5109 */
5110void
5111calculate_partition_bound_for_merge(Relation parent,
5112									List *partNames,
5113									List *partOids,
5114									PartitionBoundSpec *spec,
5115									ParseState *pstate)
5116{
5117	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5118	PartitionBoundSpec *bound;
5119
5120	Assert(!spec->is_default);
5121
5122	switch (key->strategy)
5123	{
5124		case PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE:
5125			{
5126				int			i;
5127				PartitionRangeBound **lower_bounds;
5128				int			nparts = list_length(partOids);
5129				List	   *bounds = NIL;
5130
5131				lower_bounds = palloc0_array(PartitionRangeBound *, nparts);
5132
5133				/*
5134				 * Create an array of lower bounds and a list of
5135				 * PartitionBoundSpec.
5136				 */
5137				foreach_oid(partoid, partOids)
5138				{
5139					bound = get_partition_bound_spec(partoid);
5140					i = foreach_current_index(partoid);
5141
5142					lower_bounds[i] = make_one_partition_rbound(key, i, bound->lowerdatums, true);
5143					bounds = lappend(bounds, bound);
5144				}
5145
5146				/* Sort the array of lower bounds. */
5147				qsort_arg(lower_bounds, nparts, sizeof(PartitionRangeBound *),
5148						  qsort_partition_rbound_cmp, key);
5149
5150				/* Ranges of partitions should be adjacent. */
5151				for (i = 1; i < nparts; i++)
5152				{
5153					int			index = lower_bounds[i]->index;
5154					int			prev_index = lower_bounds[i - 1]->index;
5155
5156					check_two_partitions_bounds_range(parent,
5157													  (RangeVar *) list_nth(partNames, prev_index),
5158													  (PartitionBoundSpec *) list_nth(bounds, prev_index),
5159													  (RangeVar *) list_nth(partNames, index),
5160													  (PartitionBoundSpec *) list_nth(bounds, index),
5161													  false,
5162													  true,
5163													  pstate);
5164				}
5165
5166				/*
5167				 * The lower bound of the first partition is the lower bound
5168				 * of the merged partition.
5169				 */
5170				spec->lowerdatums =
5171					((PartitionBoundSpec *) list_nth(bounds, lower_bounds[0]->index))->lowerdatums;
5172
5173				/*
5174				 * The upper bound of the last partition is the upper bound of
5175				 * the merged partition.
5176				 */
5177				spec->upperdatums =
5178					((PartitionBoundSpec *) list_nth(bounds, lower_bounds[nparts - 1]->index))->upperdatums;
5179
5180				pfree(lower_bounds);
5181				list_free(bounds);
5182				break;
5183			}
5184
5185		case PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST:
5186			{
5187				/* Consolidate bounds for all partitions in the list. */
5188				foreach_oid(partoid, partOids)
5189				{
5190					bound = get_partition_bound_spec(partoid);
5191					spec->listdatums = list_concat(spec->listdatums, bound->listdatums);
5192				}
5193				break;
5194			}
5195
5196		default:
5197			elog(ERROR, "unexpected partition strategy: %d",
5198				 (int) key->strategy);
5199	}
5200}
5201
5202/*
5203 * partitions_listdatum_intersection
5204 *
5205 * (function for BY LIST partitioning)
5206 *
5207 * Function compares lists of values for different partitions.
5208 * Return a list that contains *one* cell that is present in both list1 and
5209 * list2.  The returned list is freshly allocated via palloc(), but the
5210 * cells themselves point to the same objects as the cells of the
5211 * input lists.
5212 *
5213 * Currently, there is no need to collect all common partition datums from the
5214 * two lists.
5215 */
5216static List *
5217partitions_listdatum_intersection(FmgrInfo *partsupfunc, Oid *partcollation,
5218								  const List *list1, const List *list2)
5219{
5220	List	   *result = NIL;
5221
5222	if (list1 == NIL || list2 == NIL)
5223		return result;
5224
5225	foreach_node(Const, val1, list1)
5226	{
5227		bool		isnull1 = val1->constisnull;
5228
5229		foreach_node(Const, val2, list2)
5230		{
5231			if (val2->constisnull)
5232			{
5233				if (isnull1)
5234				{
5235					result = lappend(result, val1);
5236					return result;
5237				}
5238				continue;
5239			}
5240			else if (isnull1)
5241				continue;
5242
5243			/* Compare two datum values. */
5244			if (DatumGetInt32(FunctionCall2Coll(&partsupfunc[0],
5245												partcollation[0],
5246												val1->constvalue,
5247												val2->constvalue)) == 0)
5248			{
5249				result = lappend(result, val1);
5250				return result;
5251			}
5252		}
5253	}
5254
5255	return result;
5256}
5257
5258/*
5259 * check_partitions_not_overlap_list
5260 *
5261 * (function for BY LIST partitioning)
5262 *
5263 * This is a helper function for check_partitions_for_split().
5264 * Checks that the values of the new partitions do not overlap.
5265 *
5266 * parent:	partitioned table
5267 * parts:	array of SinglePartitionSpec structs with info about split partitions
5268 * nparts:	size of array "parts"
5269 */
5270static void
5271check_partitions_not_overlap_list(Relation parent,
5272								  SinglePartitionSpec **parts,
5273								  int nparts,
5274								  ParseState *pstate)
5275{
5276	PartitionKey key PG_USED_FOR_ASSERTS_ONLY = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5277	int			i,
5278				j;
5279	SinglePartitionSpec *sps1,
5280			   *sps2;
5281	List	   *overlap;
5282
5283	Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5284
5285	for (i = 0; i < nparts; i++)
5286	{
5287		sps1 = parts[i];
5288
5289		for (j = i + 1; j < nparts; j++)
5290		{
5291			sps2 = parts[j];
5292
5293			overlap = partitions_listdatum_intersection(&key->partsupfunc[0],
5294														key->partcollation,
5295														sps1->bound->listdatums,
5296														sps2->bound->listdatums);
5297			if (list_length(overlap) > 0)
5298			{
5299				Const	   *val = (Const *) linitial_node(Const, overlap);
5300
5301				ereport(ERROR,
5302						errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5303						errmsg("new partition \"%s\" would overlap with another new partition \"%s\"",
5304							   sps1->name->relname, sps2->name->relname),
5305						parser_errposition(pstate, exprLocation((Node *) val)));
5306			}
5307		}
5308	}
5309}
5310
5311/*
5312 * check_partition_bounds_for_split_range
5313 *
5314 * (function for BY RANGE partitioning)
5315 *
5316 * Checks that bounds of new partition "spec" are inside bounds of split
5317 * partition (with Oid splitPartOid). If first=true (this means that "spec" is
5318 * the first of the new partitions), then the lower bound of "spec" should be
5319 * equal (or greater than or equal in case defaultPart=true) to the lower
5320 * bound of the split partition. If last=true (this means that "spec" is the
5321 * last of the new partitions), then the upper bound of "spec" should be
5322 * equal (or less than or equal in case defaultPart=true) to the upper bound
5323 * of the split partition.
5324 *
5325 * parent:			partitioned table
5326 * relname:			name of the new partition
5327 * spec:			bounds specification of the new partition
5328 * splitPartOid:	split partition Oid
5329 * first:			true iff the new partition "spec" is the first of the
5330 *					new partitions
5331 * last:			true iff the new partition "spec" is the last of the
5332 *					new partitions
5333 * defaultPart:		true iff new partitions contain the DEFAULT partition
5334 * pstate:			pointer to ParseState struct to determine error position
5335 */
5336static void
5337check_partition_bounds_for_split_range(Relation parent,
5338									   char *relname,
5339									   PartitionBoundSpec *spec,
5340									   Oid splitPartOid,
5341									   bool first,
5342									   bool last,
5343									   bool defaultPart,
5344									   ParseState *pstate)
5345{
5346	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5347	PartitionRangeBound *lower,
5348			   *upper;
5349	int			cmpval;
5350
5351	Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE);
5352	Assert(spec->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE);
5353
5354	lower = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, spec->lowerdatums, true);
5355	upper = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, spec->upperdatums, false);
5356
5357	/*
5358	 * First, check if the resulting range would be empty with the specified
5359	 * lower and upper bounds.  partition_rbound_cmp cannot return zero here,
5360	 * since the lower-bound flags are different.
5361	 */
5362	cmpval = partition_rbound_cmp(key->partnatts,
5363								  key->partsupfunc,
5364								  key->partcollation,
5365								  lower->datums, lower->kind,
5366								  true, upper);
5367	Assert(cmpval != 0);
5368	if (cmpval > 0)
5369	{
5370		/* Point to the problematic key in the lower datums list. */
5371		PartitionRangeDatum *datum = list_nth(spec->lowerdatums, cmpval - 1);
5372
5373		ereport(ERROR,
5374				errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5375				errmsg("empty range bound specified for partition \"%s\"",
5376					   relname),
5377				errdetail("Specified lower bound %s is greater than or equal to upper bound %s.",
5378						  get_range_partbound_string(spec->lowerdatums),
5379						  get_range_partbound_string(spec->upperdatums)),
5380				parser_errposition(pstate, exprLocation((Node *) datum)));
5381	}
5382
5383	/*
5384	 * Need to check first and last partitions (from the set of new
5385	 * partitions)
5386	 */
5387	if (first || last)
5388	{
5389		PartitionBoundSpec *split_spec = get_partition_bound_spec(splitPartOid);
5390		PartitionRangeDatum *datum;
5391
5392		if (first)
5393		{
5394			PartitionRangeBound *split_lower;
5395
5396			split_lower = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, split_spec->lowerdatums, true);
5397
5398			cmpval = partition_rbound_cmp(key->partnatts,
5399										  key->partsupfunc,
5400										  key->partcollation,
5401										  lower->datums, lower->kind,
5402										  true, split_lower);
5403			if (cmpval != 0)
5404				datum = list_nth(spec->lowerdatums, abs(cmpval) - 1);
5405
5406			/*
5407			 * The lower bound of "spec" must equal the lower bound of the
5408			 * split partition.  However, if one of the new partitions is
5409			 * DEFAULT, then it is ok for the new partition's lower bound to
5410			 * be greater than that of the split partition.
5411			 */
5412			if (!defaultPart)
5413			{
5414				if (cmpval != 0)
5415					ereport(ERROR,
5416							errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5417							errmsg("lower bound of partition \"%s\" is not equal to lower bound of split partition \"%s\"",
5418								   relname,
5419								   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5420							errhint("%s requires the combined bounds of the new partitions to exactly match the bound of the split partition.",
5421									"ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT PARTITION"),
5422							parser_errposition(pstate, exprLocation((Node *) datum)));
5423			}
5424			else if (cmpval < 0)
5425				ereport(ERROR,
5426						errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5427						errmsg("lower bound of partition \"%s\" is less than lower bound of split partition \"%s\"",
5428							   relname,
5429							   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5430						errhint("Explicit partition bounds must be contained within the bounds of the split partition when a DEFAULT partition is specified."),
5431						parser_errposition(pstate, exprLocation((Node *) datum)));
5432		}
5433
5434		if (last)
5435		{
5436			PartitionRangeBound *split_upper;
5437
5438			split_upper = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, split_spec->upperdatums, false);
5439
5440			cmpval = partition_rbound_cmp(key->partnatts,
5441										  key->partsupfunc,
5442										  key->partcollation,
5443										  upper->datums, upper->kind,
5444										  false, split_upper);
5445			if (cmpval != 0)
5446				datum = list_nth(spec->upperdatums, abs(cmpval) - 1);
5447
5448			/*
5449			 * The upper bound of "spec" must equal the upper bound of the
5450			 * split partition.  However, if one of the new partitions is
5451			 * DEFAULT, then it is ok for the new partition's upper bound to
5452			 * be less than that of the split partition.
5453			 */
5454			if (!defaultPart)
5455			{
5456				if (cmpval != 0)
5457					ereport(ERROR,
5458							errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5459							errmsg("upper bound of partition \"%s\" is not equal to upper bound of split partition \"%s\"",
5460								   relname,
5461								   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5462							errhint("%s requires the combined bounds of the new partitions to exactly match the bound of the split partition.",
5463									"ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT PARTITION"),
5464							parser_errposition(pstate, exprLocation((Node *) datum)));
5465			}
5466			else if (cmpval > 0)
5467				ereport(ERROR,
5468						errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5469						errmsg("upper bound of partition \"%s\" is greater than upper bound of split partition \"%s\"",
5470							   relname,
5471							   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5472						errhint("Explicit partition bounds must be contained within the bounds of the split partition when a DEFAULT partition is specified."),
5473						parser_errposition(pstate, exprLocation((Node *) datum)));
5474		}
5475	}
5476}
5477
5478/*
5479 * check_partition_bounds_for_split_list
5480 *
5481 * (function for BY LIST partitioning)
5482 *
5483 * Checks that the bounds of the new partition are inside the bounds of the
5484 * split partition (with Oid splitPartOid).
5485 *
5486 * parent:			partitioned table
5487 * relname:			name of the new partition
5488 * spec:			bounds specification of the new partition
5489 * splitPartOid:	split partition Oid
5490 * pstate:			pointer to ParseState struct to determine error position
5491 */
5492static void
5493check_partition_bounds_for_split_list(Relation parent, char *relname,
5494									  PartitionBoundSpec *spec,
5495									  Oid splitPartOid,
5496									  ParseState *pstate)
5497{
5498	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5499	PartitionDesc partdesc = RelationGetPartitionDesc(parent, false);
5500	PartitionBoundInfo boundinfo = partdesc->boundinfo;
5501	int			with = -1;
5502	bool		overlap = false;
5503	int			overlap_location = -1;
5504
5505	Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5506	Assert(spec->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5507	Assert(boundinfo && boundinfo->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5508
5509	/*
5510	 * Search each value of the new partition "spec" in the existing
5511	 * partitions.  All of them should be in the split partition (with Oid
5512	 * splitPartOid).
5513	 */
5514	foreach_node(Const, val, spec->listdatums)
5515	{
5516		overlap_location = exprLocation((Node *) val);
5517		if (!val->constisnull)
5518		{
5519			int			offset;
5520			bool		equal;
5521
5522			offset = partition_list_bsearch(&key->partsupfunc[0],
5523											key->partcollation,
5524											boundinfo,
5525											val->constvalue,
5526											&equal);
5527			if (offset >= 0 && equal)
5528			{
5529				with = boundinfo->indexes[offset];
5530				if (partdesc->oids[with] != splitPartOid)
5531				{
5532					overlap = true;
5533					break;
5534				}
5535			}
5536			else
5537				ereport(ERROR,
5538						errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5539						errmsg("new partition \"%s\" cannot have this value because split partition \"%s\" does not have it",
5540							   relname,
5541							   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5542						parser_errposition(pstate, overlap_location));
5543		}
5544		else if (partition_bound_accepts_nulls(boundinfo))
5545		{
5546			with = boundinfo->null_index;
5547			if (partdesc->oids[with] != splitPartOid)
5548			{
5549				overlap = true;
5550				break;
5551			}
5552		}
5553		else
5554			ereport(ERROR,
5555					errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5556					errmsg("new partition \"%s\" cannot have NULL value because split partition \"%s\" does not have it",
5557						   relname,
5558						   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5559					parser_errposition(pstate, overlap_location));
5560	}
5561
5562	if (overlap)
5563	{
5564		Assert(with >= 0);
5565		ereport(ERROR,
5566				errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5567				errmsg("new partition \"%s\" would overlap with another (not split) partition \"%s\"",
5568					   relname, get_rel_name(partdesc->oids[with])),
5569				parser_errposition(pstate, overlap_location));
5570	}
5571}
5572
5573/*
5574 * find_value_in_new_partitions_list
5575 *
5576 * (function for BY LIST partitioning)
5577 *
5578 * Function returns true iff any of the new partitions contains the value
5579 * "value".
5580 *
5581 * partsupfunc:		information about the comparison function associated with
5582 *					the partition key
5583 * partcollation:	partitioning collation
5584 * parts:			pointer to an array with new partition descriptions
5585 * nparts:			number of new partitions
5586 * value:			the value that we are looking for
5587 * isnull:			true if the value that we are looking for is NULL
5588 */
5589static bool
5590find_value_in_new_partitions_list(FmgrInfo *partsupfunc,
5591								  Oid *partcollation,
5592								  SinglePartitionSpec **parts,
5593								  int nparts,
5594								  Datum value,
5595								  bool isnull)
5596{
5597	for (int i = 0; i < nparts; i++)
5598	{
5599		SinglePartitionSpec *sps = parts[i];
5600
5601		foreach_node(Const, val, sps->bound->listdatums)
5602		{
5603			if (isnull && val->constisnull)
5604				return true;
5605
5606			if (!isnull && !val->constisnull)
5607			{
5608				if (DatumGetInt32(FunctionCall2Coll(&partsupfunc[0],
5609													partcollation[0],
5610													val->constvalue,
5611													value)) == 0)
5612					return true;
5613			}
5614		}
5615	}
5616	return false;
5617}
5618
5619/*
5620 * check_parent_values_in_new_partitions
5621 *
5622 * (function for BY LIST partitioning)
5623 *
5624 * Checks that all values of split partition (with Oid partOid) are contained
5625 * in new partitions.
5626 *
5627 * parent:	partitioned table
5628 * partOid:	split partition Oid
5629 * parts:	pointer to an array with new partition descriptions
5630 * nparts:	number of new partitions
5631 * pstate:	pointer to ParseState struct to determine error position
5632 */
5633static void
5634check_parent_values_in_new_partitions(Relation parent,
5635									  Oid partOid,
5636									  SinglePartitionSpec **parts,
5637									  int nparts,
5638									  ParseState *pstate)
5639{
5640	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5641	PartitionDesc partdesc = RelationGetPartitionDesc(parent, false);
5642	PartitionBoundInfo boundinfo = partdesc->boundinfo;
5643	int			i;
5644	bool		found = true;
5645	Datum		datum = PointerGetDatum(NULL);
5646
5647	Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5648
5649	/*
5650	 * Special processing for NULL value. Search for a NULL value if the split
5651	 * partition (partOid) contains it.
5652	 */
5653	if (partition_bound_accepts_nulls(boundinfo) &&
5654		partdesc->oids[boundinfo->null_index] == partOid)
5655	{
5656		if (!find_value_in_new_partitions_list(&key->partsupfunc[0],
5657											   key->partcollation, parts, nparts, datum, true))
5658			found = false;
5659	}
5660
5661	if (!found)
5662		ereport(ERROR,
5663				errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5664				errmsg("new partitions' combined partition bounds do not contain value (%s) but split partition \"%s\" does",
5665					   "NULL",
5666					   get_rel_name(partOid)),
5667				errhint("%s requires the combined bounds of the new partitions to exactly match the bound of the split partition.",
5668						"ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT PARTITION"));
5669
5670	/*
5671	 * Search all values of split partition with partOid in the PartitionDesc
5672	 * of partitioned table.
5673	 */
5674	for (i = 0; i < boundinfo->ndatums; i++)
5675	{
5676		if (partdesc->oids[boundinfo->indexes[i]] == partOid)
5677		{
5678			/* We found the value that the split partition contains. */
5679			datum = boundinfo->datums[i][0];
5680			if (!find_value_in_new_partitions_list(&key->partsupfunc[0],
5681												   key->partcollation, parts, nparts, datum, false))
5682			{
5683				found = false;
5684				break;
5685			}
5686		}
5687	}
5688
5689	if (!found)
5690	{
5691		Const	   *notFoundVal;
5692
5693		/*
5694		 * Make a Const for getting the string representation of the missing
5695		 * value.
5696		 */
5697		notFoundVal = makeConst(key->parttypid[0],
5698								key->parttypmod[0],
5699								key->parttypcoll[0],
5700								key->parttyplen[0],
5701								datum,
5702								false,	/* isnull */
5703								key->parttypbyval[0]);
5704
5705		ereport(ERROR,
5706				errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5707				errmsg("new partitions' combined partition bounds do not contain value (%s) but split partition \"%s\" does",
5708					   deparse_expression((Node *) notFoundVal, NIL, false, false),
5709					   get_rel_name(partOid)),
5710				errhint("%s requires the combined bounds of the new partitions to exactly match the bound of the split partition.",
5711						"ALTER TABLE ... SPLIT PARTITION"));
5712	}
5713}
5714
5715/*
5716 * split_partition_values_contained_in_new_part
5717 *
5718 * (function for BY LIST partitioning)
5719 *
5720 * Returns true if all values in the LIST bound of the partition being split
5721 * are contained in the specified non-DEFAULT replacement partition's bound.
5722 *
5723 * The caller must already have verified containment in the other direction,
5724 * so this check is sufficient to prove that the two LIST bounds are equal.
5725 */
5726static bool
5727split_partition_values_contained_in_new_part(Relation parent,
5728											 Oid splitPartOid,
5729											 SinglePartitionSpec *part)
5730{
5731	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5732	PartitionDesc partdesc = RelationGetPartitionDesc(parent, false);
5733	PartitionBoundInfo boundinfo = partdesc->boundinfo;
5734	SinglePartitionSpec *parts[1];
5735	Datum		datum = PointerGetDatum(NULL);
5736
5737	Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5738
5739	parts[0] = part;
5740
5741	/*
5742	 * Special processing for NULL value.  Search for a NULL value if the
5743	 * split partition contains it.
5744	 */
5745	if (partition_bound_accepts_nulls(boundinfo) &&
5746		partdesc->oids[boundinfo->null_index] == splitPartOid)
5747	{
5748		if (!find_value_in_new_partitions_list(&key->partsupfunc[0],
5749											   key->partcollation, parts, 1,
5750											   datum, true))
5751			return false;
5752	}
5753
5754	/*
5755	 * Search all values of the split partition in the single non-DEFAULT
5756	 * replacement partition.
5757	 */
5758	for (int i = 0; i < boundinfo->ndatums; i++)
5759	{
5760		if (partdesc->oids[boundinfo->indexes[i]] == splitPartOid)
5761		{
5762			datum = boundinfo->datums[i][0];
5763
5764			if (!find_value_in_new_partitions_list(&key->partsupfunc[0],
5765												   key->partcollation, parts, 1,
5766												   datum, false))
5767				return false;
5768		}
5769	}
5770
5771	return true;
5772}
5773
5774/*
5775 * check_split_partition_not_same_bound
5776 *
5777 * Reject splitting a non-DEFAULT partition into one non-DEFAULT partition
5778 * with the original bound plus a DEFAULT partition.  That form does not
5779 * perform a real split; it merely adds a DEFAULT partition to the parent
5780 * table through the split-partition path.  Users should use
5781 * CREATE TABLE ... PARTITION OF ... DEFAULT or ALTER TABLE ... ATTACH
5782 * PARTITION ... DEFAULT for that.
5783 *
5784 * Must be called after the per-partition bound validation in
5785 * check_partitions_for_split() so that containment of new bounds within the
5786 * split partition is already established.  Given containment, RANGE bounds
5787 * are equal iff their lower and upper rbounds match; LIST bound sets are
5788 * equal iff the split partition's values are also contained in the new
5789 * partition (the containment is then bidirectional).  Both checks go
5790 * through the partition operator family (partition_rbound_cmp /
5791 * find_value_in_new_partitions_list) rather than byte equality, so e.g.
5792 * -0.0 and 0.0 -- which have different bit patterns but compare equal
5793 * under float8 -- are correctly recognised as the same bound.
5794 */
5795static void
5796check_split_partition_not_same_bound(Relation parent,
5797									 Oid splitPartOid,
5798									 SinglePartitionSpec **parts,
5799									 int nparts,
5800									 ParseState *pstate)
5801{
5802	PartitionKey key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5803	PartitionBoundSpec *new_spec;
5804	PartitionBoundSpec *split_spec;
5805
5806	if (nparts != 1)
5807		return;
5808
5809	new_spec = parts[0]->bound;
5810	split_spec = get_partition_bound_spec(splitPartOid);
5811
5812	Assert(new_spec->strategy == split_spec->strategy);
5813
5814	if (key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE)
5815	{
5816		PartitionRangeBound *new_lower;
5817		PartitionRangeBound *new_upper;
5818		PartitionRangeBound *split_lower;
5819		PartitionRangeBound *split_upper;
5820
5821		new_lower = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, new_spec->lowerdatums, true);
5822		new_upper = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, new_spec->upperdatums, false);
5823		split_lower = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, split_spec->lowerdatums, true);
5824		split_upper = make_one_partition_rbound(key, -1, split_spec->upperdatums, false);
5825
5826		if (partition_rbound_cmp(key->partnatts, key->partsupfunc,
5827								 key->partcollation,
5828								 new_lower->datums, new_lower->kind, true,
5829								 split_lower) != 0)
5830			return;
5831		if (partition_rbound_cmp(key->partnatts, key->partsupfunc,
5832								 key->partcollation,
5833								 new_upper->datums, new_upper->kind, false,
5834								 split_upper) != 0)
5835			return;
5836	}
5837	else
5838	{
5839		Assert(key->strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5840
5841		if (!split_partition_values_contained_in_new_part(parent, splitPartOid,
5842														  parts[0]))
5843			return;
5844	}
5845
5846	ereport(ERROR,
5847			errcode(ERRCODE_INVALID_OBJECT_DEFINITION),
5848			errmsg("cannot split partition \"%s\" only to add a DEFAULT partition",
5849				   get_rel_name(splitPartOid)),
5850			errdetail("The non-DEFAULT partition would keep the same partition bound."),
5851			errhint("Use CREATE TABLE ... PARTITION OF ... DEFAULT to add a DEFAULT partition."),
5852			parser_errposition(pstate, parts[0]->name->location));
5853}
5854
5855/*
5856 * check_partitions_for_split
5857 *
5858 * Checks new partitions for the SPLIT PARTITION command:
5859 * 1. Bounds of new partitions should not overlap with new and existing
5860 *	  partitions.
5861 * 2. In the case when new or existing partitions contain the DEFAULT
5862 *	  partition, new partitions can have any bounds inside the split partition
5863 *	  bound (can be spaces between partition bounds).
5864 * 3. In case new partitions don't contain the DEFAULT partition and the
5865 *	  partitioned table does not have the DEFAULT partition, the following
5866 *	  should be true: the sum of the bounds of new partitions should be equal
5867 *	  to the bound of the split partition.
5868 *
5869 * parent:			partitioned table
5870 * splitPartOid:	split partition Oid
5871 * partlist:		list of new partitions after partition split
5872 * pstate:			pointer to ParseState struct for determine error position
5873 */
5874void
5875check_partitions_for_split(Relation parent,
5876						   Oid splitPartOid,
5877						   List *partlist,
5878						   ParseState *pstate)
5879{
5880	PartitionKey key;
5881	char		strategy;
5882	Oid			defaultPartOid;
5883	bool		isSplitPartDefault;
5884	bool		createDefaultPart = false;
5885	int			default_index = -1;
5886	int			i;
5887	SinglePartitionSpec **new_parts;
5888	SinglePartitionSpec *spsPrev = NULL;
5889
5890	/*
5891	 * nparts counts the number of split partitions, but it exclude the
5892	 * default partition.
5893	 */
5894	int			nparts = 0;
5895
5896	key = RelationGetPartitionKey(parent);
5897	strategy = get_partition_strategy(key);
5898
5899	defaultPartOid =
5900		get_default_oid_from_partdesc(RelationGetPartitionDesc(parent, true));
5901
5902	Assert(strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE ||
5903		   strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST);
5904
5905	/*
5906	 * Make an array new_parts with new partitions except the DEFAULT
5907	 * partition.
5908	 */
5909	new_parts = palloc0_array(SinglePartitionSpec *, list_length(partlist));
5910
5911	/* isSplitPartDefault flag: is split partition a DEFAULT partition? */
5912	isSplitPartDefault = (defaultPartOid == splitPartOid);
5913
5914	foreach_node(SinglePartitionSpec, sps, partlist)
5915	{
5916		if (sps->bound->is_default)
5917			default_index = foreach_current_index(sps);
5918		else
5919			new_parts[nparts++] = sps;
5920	}
5921
5922	/* An indicator that the DEFAULT partition will be created. */
5923	if (default_index != -1)
5924	{
5925		createDefaultPart = true;
5926		Assert(nparts == list_length(partlist) - 1);
5927	}
5928
5929	if (strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE)
5930	{
5931		PartitionRangeBound **lower_bounds;
5932		SinglePartitionSpec **tmp_new_parts;
5933
5934		/*
5935		 * To simplify the check for ranges of new partitions, we need to sort
5936		 * all partitions in ascending order of their bounds (we compare the
5937		 * lower bound only).
5938		 */
5939		lower_bounds = palloc0_array(PartitionRangeBound *, nparts);
5940
5941		/* Create an array of lower bounds. */
5942		for (i = 0; i < nparts; i++)
5943		{
5944			lower_bounds[i] = make_one_partition_rbound(key, i,
5945														new_parts[i]->bound->lowerdatums, true);
5946		}
5947
5948		/* Sort the array of lower bounds. */
5949		qsort_arg(lower_bounds, nparts, sizeof(PartitionRangeBound *),
5950				  qsort_partition_rbound_cmp, (void *) key);
5951
5952		/* Reorder the array of partitions. */
5953		tmp_new_parts = new_parts;
5954		new_parts = palloc0_array(SinglePartitionSpec *, nparts);
5955		for (i = 0; i < nparts; i++)
5956			new_parts[i] = tmp_new_parts[lower_bounds[i]->index];
5957
5958		pfree(tmp_new_parts);
5959		pfree(lower_bounds);
5960	}
5961
5962	for (i = 0; i < nparts; i++)
5963	{
5964		SinglePartitionSpec *sps = new_parts[i];
5965
5966		if (isSplitPartDefault)
5967		{
5968			/*
5969			 * When the split partition is the DEFAULT partition, we can use
5970			 * any free ranges - as when creating a new partition.
5971			 */
5972			check_new_partition_bound(sps->name->relname, parent, sps->bound,
5973									  pstate);
5974		}
5975		else
5976		{
5977			/*
5978			 * Checks that the bounds of the current partition are inside the
5979			 * bounds of the split partition. For range partitioning: checks
5980			 * that the upper bound of the previous partition is equal to the
5981			 * lower bound of the current partition. For list partitioning:
5982			 * checks that the split partition contains all values of the
5983			 * current partition.
5984			 */
5985			if (strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE)
5986			{
5987				bool		first = (i == 0);
5988				bool		last = (i == (nparts - 1));
5989
5990				check_partition_bounds_for_split_range(parent, sps->name->relname, sps->bound,
5991													   splitPartOid, first, last,
5992													   createDefaultPart, pstate);
5993			}
5994			else
5995				check_partition_bounds_for_split_list(parent, sps->name->relname,
5996													  sps->bound, splitPartOid, pstate);
5997		}
5998
5999		/* Ranges of new partitions should not overlap. */
6000		if (strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_RANGE && spsPrev)
6001			check_two_partitions_bounds_range(parent, spsPrev->name, spsPrev->bound,
6002											  sps->name, sps->bound,
6003											  createDefaultPart,
6004											  false,
6005											  pstate);
6006
6007		spsPrev = sps;
6008	}
6009
6010	if (strategy == PARTITION_STRATEGY_LIST)
6011	{
6012		/* Values of new partitions should not overlap. */
6013		check_partitions_not_overlap_list(parent, new_parts, nparts,
6014										  pstate);
6015
6016		/*
6017		 * Need to check that all values of the split partition are contained
6018		 * in the new partitions. Skip this check if the DEFAULT partition
6019		 * exists.
6020		 */
6021		if (!createDefaultPart)
6022			check_parent_values_in_new_partitions(parent, splitPartOid,
6023												  new_parts, nparts, pstate);
6024	}
6025
6026	/*
6027	 * Reject the degenerate form where the single non-DEFAULT replacement
6028	 * partition keeps the bound of the split partition; the command then does
6029	 * nothing beyond adding a DEFAULT partition.  Containment was established
6030	 * by the per-partition validation above, so an equality check is enough.
6031	 */
6032	if (!isSplitPartDefault && createDefaultPart)
6033		check_split_partition_not_same_bound(parent, splitPartOid, new_parts,
6034											 nparts, pstate);
6035
6036	pfree(new_parts);
6037}
